title: Yale College Need-Based Financial Aid 2027-2028
duration: 4 years (renewable; international students do not need to reapply annually)
description: Yale College Need-Based Financial Aid is not a separate scholarship application: it is assessed as part of the Yale College admission application, with the applicable date being the admission plan deadline (Regular Decision February 15, 2027). The average annual need-based scholarship awarded to the class of 2029 was $75,220. For families with income below $100,000, a Yale Scholarship covers the full cost of tuition and fees, housing, food, and travel with no loans, and Yale also provides hospitalization insurance.

title: MIT Undergraduate Need-Based Financial Aid and MIT Scholarship for International Students
funding: Need-based grant aid (MIT meets 100% of demonstrated need)
program_type: Need-blind institutional need-based grant aid for undergraduate international students at a private research university.
duration: Aid is awarded for each academic year of the undergraduate degree and reviewed annually; continuing students reapply by February 15.
description: MIT Student Financial Services treats students who are not eligible for federal student financial aid under the FAFSA - that is, everyone other than U.S. citizens, permanent residents and certain special cases - as 'international' for financial aid purposes, regardless of country of residence. International students go through exactly the same need-based process as domestic students, and MIT states it is committed to meeting 100% of demonstrated financial need for international students, just as for domestic students. title: UT Austin International Student Scholarships and Financial Services (Texas Global / ISSS)
official_source: Texas Global / International Student and Scholar Services, The University of Texas at Austin
program_type: University-administered needs-based, merit-based and country-restricted scholarships, cash awards and tuition exemptions for enrolled international students.
duration: One-time awards for the semester or academic year in which they are granted; recipients are not guaranteed to receive the scholarship in subsequent years.
description: The University of Texas at Austin's International Student and Scholar Services (ISSS) states that "Certain scholarship opportunities are open to international students who meet eligibility criteria", and that "Scholarship applications are open twice a year: once in the Fall for the spring and summer terms and once in the Spring for the upcoming fall term and academic year." title: University of Chicago International Student Financial Aid (Need-Based and Merit Scholarships for Undergraduates)
official_source: The University of Chicago (College Admissions and Office of Financial Aid)
program_type: Need-blind institutional need-based grant aid for international undergraduates, plus partial-tuition merit scholarships.
duration: Aid is determined during the admissions process before the first year and re-applied for in each subsequent year of the College.
description: The University of Chicago states that "Nearly $20 million in need-based financial aid has been offered to international students at UChicago over the past four years, and a recent gift of $35 million for international financial aid has strengthened the University's commitment to enrolling a diverse and talented student body from around the world." Its commitment is explicit: "We are committed to meeting 100% of your demonstrated need with a loan-free financial aid package if you are admitted and applied for funding." title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at Carnegie Mellon University Africa
program_type: Fully funded need-based graduate scholarship partnership between Carnegie Mellon University Africa and the Mastercard Foundation.
duration: Master of Science degree at CMU-Africa in Kigali, with the semester beginning in September.
description: The Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at CMU-Africa supports highly talented, service-oriented young people who face the highest social and economic barriers to opportunity as they complete Master of Science degrees in Information Technology, Electrical and Computer Engineering or Engineering Artificial Intelligence in Kigali.

title: Google PhD Fellowship Program
program_type: Industry-sponsored international doctoral fellowship awarded through university nomination.
duration: One to four years depending on region: Africa up to 3 years, Australia and New Zealand 1 year, Canada and the United States up to 2 years, East Asia 1 year, Europe and the Middle East up to 2 years, India up to 4 years for early-stage and 1 year for late-stage PhD students, Latin America up to 2 years, Southeast Asia up to 3 years.
description: Google PhD Fellowships directly support graduate students as they pursue their PhD.
